# Retrospective

Source-only scope was proportionate to a comment-only diff. Independent reviewers differed on whether a wording issue deserved public mention, not on the source control flow. Synthesis keeps a compact correction, without severity inflation, generic tests, or claims of unanimous prioritization. No runtime fixtures or desktop slots were needed.

## Deviation and remediation

Opus read 200 lines of workflow policy in one tool call. Claude Code persisted the oversized result in its native project tool-results directory outside the assignment root. This violates the intended bounded-read storage discipline. Retain that native history. Content category is workflow policy only, no PR payload or secret. Smaller subsequent chunks corrected the behavior. Publication is not held because the public claim is independently established in the pinned source and both separate finals, with no evidence/independence loss.

The coordinator assignment required current process corrections but did not explicitly restate a numeric policy-read chunk bound. Future assignments should explicitly request at most 60 lines per policy read in Claude, matching this report's remediation. No workflow code or other team's instructions were changed during this PR.

No tool bugs are established. Automatic tool-output persistence is a known CLI behavior, not evidence of an isolation defect. No PR code executed. Host source fetches, hashing and JSON parsing are source/document operations, not runtime tests. All intentional review artifacts stayed under this assignment or the mandated native editorial/session storage.

Reviewer native model/session records and launch flags verify Opus 5.5 High and Sol Xhigh even though reviewers cannot each read back every effort setting internally. No quota exception, model substitution or peer contamination. Cleanup is vacuous for runtime resources; preserve owned panes and all history. HTML saved without opening.
comment:
One small documentation correction; no behavior change is introduced.

**Verified:** The diff changes only a comment. The existing handler invokes a live `default` action when available, and restored/history rows skip the live-reference lookup.

**Documentation correction:** In [`Service.qml`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/ad093e9ab46eb213ef0e0f717f6be6ba9527f097/shell/plugins/notifications/Service.qml#L375-L400), “Reaching here means there was no action to run” also executes past a successful invocation. That wording can misdirect debugging of the very path this comment explains. The unchanged source flow is:

```text
live default action succeeds -> invoked = true  -> skip focus -> dismiss
no live default action       -> invoked = false -> focus      -> dismiss
invocation throws            -> invoked = false -> focus      -> dismiss
```

**Suggested change:** Start with “If no default action was invoked…” and describe focusing as conditional, including the caught invocation-error case. The distinction between live actions and restored/history rows can remain.
